visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with close-up shots of signage for 'SOUP CURRY KING' in a building directory and on a storefront. A crowd of people is seen waiting in a tiled stairwell, most are looking at their phones. A person wearing a black and white shirt holds a clear umbrella while another person takes a photo with their phone. (2) A hand flips through a thick menu binder with colorful tabs labeled 'Japanese', 'English', and 'Chinese'. Close-up shots display various menu pages showing colorful soup curry dishes with prices and descriptive text. (3) A female restaurant staff member wearing a black t-shirt with the 'KING' logo opens a glass door to invite customers in. The interior features wooden floors, warm lighting, and a chalkboard wall decorated with 'Hello Summer' drawings and polaroid photos. (4) The main character, a man with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a black bucket hat and a green plaid flannel shirt over a black graphic tee, is seated at a wooden table. He drinks from a glass of dark liquid and makes a satisfied face. (5) A bowl of soup curry is served alongside a plate of yellow rice. The curry contains large pieces of lotus root, carrot, corn, eggplant, and green pepper in a speckled brown broth. The man uses a spoon to lift the broth and then a piece of beef. (6) He eats the curry with the yellow rice, looking directly at the camera with wide eyes and a focused expression. He then shows a large grilled chicken leg from another bowl. The video ends with the man standing outside the restaurant wearing round sunglasses, giving a thumbs-up to the camera.
